operations.description: This API is used to bind an IP address to an endpoint.
This API is used to associate a resolver access logging configuration with a VPC.
This API is used to associate a VPC with an endpoint rule.
This API is used to associate a new VPC with a private zone after the private zone is created.

This API is used to submit the task for creating record sets for public zones in batches and return the task ID. **** **Public zones are global resources. Select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**

This API is used to submit the task for creating record sets for public zones in batches and return the task ID. **** **Public zones are global resources. Select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**
This API is used to submit the task for creating public zones in batches and return the task ID. **** **Public zones are global resources. Select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**
This API is used to submit the task for batch creating record sets and return the task ID.
This API is used to batch add or delete tags for a specific instance.
This API is used to delete PTR records in batches. This is an atomic operation. All PTR records are either deleted completely or not deleted at all.

This API is used to submit the task for deleting record sets from public zones in batches and return the task ID. **** **Public zones are global resources. Select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**
This API is used to batch delete record sets in a zone. The response contains only the record sets that are deleted. Both public and private zones are supported.
This API is used to delete record sets in batches. The response contains only the record sets that are deleted. You can delete record sets in public and private zones in batches.
This API is used to delete zones in batches. This is an atomic operation. All zones are either deleted completely or not deleted at all. Both public and private zones are supported.
This API is used to set the status of record sets in batches. The response contains only the record sets that are updated. Record sets of both public and private zones are supported.
This API is used to set the status of zones in batches. The response contains only the zones that are updated. Both public and private zones are supported.
This API is used to submit the task for transferring public zones in batches and return the task ID. **** **Public zones are global resources. Select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**

This API is used to submit the task for modifying record sets of public zones in batches and return the task ID. **** **Public zones are global resources. Select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**
This API is used to modify record sets in batches. This operation is atomic. It either modifies all record sets or does not modify any record set. Only public zones are supported.

When you create a subdomain, the system displays a message indicating that the domain conflicts with that of another tenant and you need to add a TXT record for verification. You can call the API to generate the TXT record verification information for the subdomain. **** **Public zones are global resources. You need to select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.** > After the TXT record verification information is generated, go to the DNS service provider of the second-level domain to which the subdomain belongs and add a TXT record. The name and value of the TXT record must be the same as the verification information.

After adding a TXT record at the DNS service provider of the second-level domain, you can call this API to verify the subdomain authorization status. **** **Public zones are global resources. You need to select the AP-Singapore (ap-southeast-3) region.**
